items.title: Identifying Secure Collaboration Platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, MS Teams) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Identifying Secure Collaboration Platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, MS Teams) (PDF 125, printed 121).

blocks.text: Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams jaise mehfooz collaboration platforms group work ke liye mehfooz mahol dete hain. Yeh platforms data bachane ke liye encrypted communication (code mein badli hui baat-cheet) aur access controls (kaun kya khol sake, is ka control) jaise features use karte hain. Talaba documents share kar sakte, meetings attend kar sakte aur mehfooz tareeqe se baat kar sakte hain. Bharosemand aur approved platforms chunna maloomat bachata aur cyber khatre kam karta hai. Misal: talaba school projects ke liye Google Workspace use kar sakte hain aur project file restricted access (mehdood rasai) se sirf chune hue classmates ke saath share kar sakte hain. Woh mehfooz online classes ke liye Google Meet bhi use kar sakte hain jahan sirf authorized (ijazat wale) participants hi shamil ho sakte hain. Yeh features talaba ko apna school ka kaam aur zaati maloomat bachate hue mehfooz tareeqe se mil kar kaam karne dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams data kaise mehfooz rakhte hain? Aik misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Encrypted communication aur access controls se. Misal: project file restricted access ke saath sirf chune hue classmates se share karna, ya Google Meet class jis mein sirf authorized participants shamil ho sakein.

items: Secure collaboration platforms: Google Workspace, MS Teams.
Encryption aur access controls; sirf bharosemand aur approved platforms.
